beats.text: Napoleon's army lost to a country. And English got a new word.
July 1808. At Bailén, a Spanish army forced a whole French corps to surrender. A Napoleonic army had never lost an open battle like this.
beats.say: July eighteen-oh-eight. At Bailén, a Spanish army forced a whole French corps to surrender. A Napoleonic army had never lost an open battle like this.

beats.text: Joseph fled Madrid. Napoleon came himself, with a huge army.
Zaragoza held out through two sieges, street by street. When the gunners fell, a young woman, Agustina, fired the cannon herself.
All over Spain, small bands ambushed the French and vanished. Spaniards called it guerrilla: the little war.
Both sides were brutal. Goya etched it all. The prints were so dark, they came out only after his death.
With the British under Wellington, the French were finally crushed at Vitoria. King Joseph ran for France.
Then Ferdinand came home. Spaniards had died in his name. He thanked them by tearing up their new constitution.
They had fought for their king. Their king did not fight for them.
